64:t_018:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「Was that a word you never heard in the $$人類銀河同盟$$?」

64:t_018:7.en:
$n
「Let's return. Everyone is waiting for us.」

64:t_019:0.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Damn, those guys are amazing! They're totally overwhelming!」

64:t_019:1.en:
$$エイミー$$
「We can beat the pirates with this, right!」

64:t_019:2.en:
$$ベローズ$$
(Just winning won't end the fighting...)

64:t_019:3.en:
$$ベローズ$$
(That girl, $$テッサ$$... what is she planning to do...?)

64:t_100:2.en:
$$レド$$
「What is wrong? The ene-my i-s right in fron-t of you.」

64:t_100:3.en:
$n
「Sorry. It's just... I somehow feel like I can get along with you, too.」

64:t_100:4.en:
$$レド$$
「Do you mean that we can co-ordi-nate as friend-ly forces?」

64:t_100:6.en:
$n
「Sorry for butting in with needless chatter. Let's go, $$レド$$.」

64:t_100:7.en:
$$レド$$
「Un-der-stood. I will car-ry out the mission.」

64:t_101:0.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「So my opponent is that rumored flying $$ユンボロ$$. It's been a long time since my blood ran this hot.」

64:t_101:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Warning. The target is judged to be in a class apart from the other units in performance.]

64:t_101:2.en:
$$レド$$
[But if we don't take this one down, the fighting will not end! I'm going in!]

64:t_101:4.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「So you mean to charge me recklessly. Then let me teach you.」

64:t_101:5.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Who it is that rules this $$残されの海$$!」

64:t_102:0.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Even here, there are those who defy me...!」

64:t_102:1.en:
$n
「I like to think I know how to handle strong-willed women.」

64:t_102:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$n! It's rude to talk about $$千鳥$$ like that!」

64:t_102:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Oh... or were you talking about $$クラン$$? Or $$葵$$? Or $$カレン$$?」

64:t_102:6.en:
$$スズネ$$
「What's with that attitude...! If you have something to say, say it straight!」

64:t_102:7.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Don't you dare ignore me and get all worked up between the two of you!」

64:t_102:8.en:
$n
(You saved me, lady pirate...! I'll thank you in my heart, for the record!)

64:t_103:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「Like I'd be scared off by titles like Empress or Queen!」

64:t_103:1.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「This man...! He's not afraid of me at all!?」

64:t_103:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'm not letting a woman jerk me around even on the battlefield!!」

64:t_104:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「Whoa...! That design would make even a $$機械獣$$ turn pale!」

64:t_104:1.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Hehe... this man seems to be captivated by the splendor of my $$ユンボロ$$.」

64:t_104:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「How do you get that out of it!?」

64:t_104:3.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Then, as your reward, I shall bury you in a single blow!」

64:t_104:4.en:
$$甲児$$
「Not happening! I'll grill you whole with Breast Fire!」

64:t_105:0.en:
$$アル$$
「Underwater combat is disadvantageous for this unit. I recommend luring the enemy onto the deck and fighting there.」

64:t_105:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「Don't expect the enemy to move the way we want. Besides, beating her underwater is what matters.」

64:t_105:2.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「You challenge me head-on? Such ignorance of your own place goes beyond all bounds.」

64:t_105:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm not the one who will defeat you! All we do is stop you in your tracks!」

64:t_106:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Let's go, Shrimp Robot! I'll peel your shell and turn you into sashimi!」

64:t_106:1.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Hehehe, little boy. That's quite brave talk.」

64:t_106:2.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「I shall teach a boy like you the harshness of the sea and how frightening women can be.」

64:t_106:3.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I won't lose! If you're the Empress, then I'm the elementary school president!!」

64:t_107:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I've even fought $$ブランチ$$'s crab-type robots! I won't lose to a shrimp-type robot!」

64:t_107:1.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「You have spirit, boy. But don't think you can beat $$ラケージ$$ at sea.」

64:t_107:2.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$鉄人$$ won't lose, be it in the sky, at sea, or at the ends of the earth! If your opponent is a villain, you can't afford to lose!!」

64:t_108:0.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「What is this thing...!? A ship traveling through the sea!」

64:t_108:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Empress $$ラケージ$$...! That title ends today!」

64:t_108:2.en:
$$テッサ$$
「And I will teach you who the true Queen of the Sea is!」

64:t_109:0.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「A grand brawl on the wide open sea! The enemy is a lawless lady pirate!」

64:t_109:1.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「It's just like an adventure serial! It's the kind of thing that raises morale!!」
